{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of the 'responded' variable across arms
print('Total patients:', len(trial_df))
print('Patients by arm:')
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check for any systematic differences in baseline characteristics
print('\nBaseline age by arm:')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['age'].mean())

print('\nBaseline sex by arm:')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['sex'].value_counts())

print('\nBaseline severity by arm:')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts())"}
